evidence.reason: The admission marker's own token file is fsynced, but the parent directory is not fsynced after the marker is created (and the same omission exists on removal/release). On Linux, fsync of a newly created file does not guarantee its directory entry survives a power loss, so the code's stated guarantee that the token is 'persisted' and proves ownership is incomplete. This is a concrete crash-consistency defect in the existing admission-hold behavior, not merely a request to add a new feature. The smallest fix is to fsync the marker directory after creation and unlink, mapping sync failure to the existing RecoveryRequired/Refused handling.
